DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", incident_type_cause_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_causes WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_causes (incident_type_id, incident_type_cause_id, alias, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentTypeId, :id=getNextId{'conf.ims_incident_type_causes'$'incident_type_cause_id'$'incident_type_id=incidentTypeId'}, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_type_causes SET enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId incident_type_cause_id = :id
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.ims_incident_type_causes WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND incident_type_cause_id = :id
